scope: runtime UI candidates; source Narrative files preserved

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait background plate for a real dark fantasy game interface, login/content patch screens and shared menu atmosphere.
Input image 1 is an approved style and palette reference ONLY; do not modify it or reproduce its characters, logo, lettering, sword mark or poster layout.
Primary request: Create a new TEXT-FREE background derived from the reference's painterly gothic anime/light novel world. A deserted stone approach between tall gothic cathedral structures, distant black eclipse with a restrained thin crimson rim, worn iron, wet stone, faint ash and mist, warm candlelight at the far left and right edges. Deep black/charcoal and muted burgundy, aged warm brass glints, ivory candle flame. Sophisticated painted architectural detail at the edges, large calm dark central and lower areas for live UI Controls.
Composition: portrait 9:16. Cathedral spires and eclipse mainly in upper third. Dark unobstructed center from 40% down and lower half; no bright focal light behind text. Cohesive with the approved reference, not neon sci-fi. Atmospheric quiet rather than explosive.
Constraints: no people, no characters, no recognizable new story location, no creatures, no UI, no frames, no buttons, no letters, no logo, no text, no watermark. Architecture is a decorative non-canon UI backdrop. Crisp high-quality illustration, no artificial blur.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: text-free runtime title-screen background adaptation of an approved game poster.
Edit target is the attached image. Preserve the composition, Fadyme's exact face, violet eyes, silver-white hair, hood, outfit, accessories, Mahmut's exact face/armor/red scarf, architecture, eclipse and lighting. Do not change these identity anchors.
Change only the lower part which contains the large UNAWARE / OF MY DEMISE wordmark, red logo symbol, subtitle PART I and ornamental text rules: remove all of that lettering, logo symbol and the rules completely. Continue the existing dark folds, stone and faint candle reflections behind the removed region. Keep this lower area calm, dark and legible for a separately composited approved transparent logo and live Tap to Start text. Preserve the existing 9:16 portrait framing and all upper/middle illustration details.
No new characters, no new objects, no letters, no title, no logos, no watermark. This is a background only.
